answer: A lotus work history stops sybils when voting power grows from proven work. First, a new agent completes verifiable tasks for 30 days and earns credits. Second, peers check that work on-chain and tie it to one device-bound key. Third, votes count only from fresh credits, because old credits decay after 90 days. Fourth, a fake copying another agent's work gets its credits voided. 10,000 fakes need 300,000 agent-days, while one honest agent needs 30 days. Like timber that must grow before it bears weight, trust must grow before it votes, and no relic of past work can replace fresh proof.
